verdict.rationale: Reflect is a cloud-hosted, closed-source note app with no self-hosted backend option; evidence only shows E2E encryption and export to Markdown/HTML for portability, not a local-only or self-hosted sync mode. A commenter even suggested open-sourcing as a hypothetical safeguard, confirming no such option currently exists. Missing for 10: any documented local-only mode, self-hosted sync server, or offline-first architecture independent of Reflect's cloud.
